title: Effects needing attention
loadFailed: Invoice effects could not be loaded. Refresh to try again.
dismissTitle: Mark this effect as handled by hand?
dismissHelp: Dismiss removes this effect from Health and stops its automatic recovery. It does not run the effect or change the invoice. Use this only if it was handled by hand or no longer needs to run.
recoveryBudget: If this run fails, automatic recovery gets five more resets. It will appear here again if those are exhausted.
actionFailed: The action could not be completed. Refresh to check whether this effect was already retried, completed or dismissed.
consequence.receipt: This sends the receipt email now.
consequence.activate_memberships: This activates eligible memberships and grants any class pack credits for this paid invoice now.
consequence.reverse_credits: This reverses the invoice's class pack credits now.
consequence.dunning: This sends the dunning email now if this is still the current failure on an unpaid recurring invoice.
consequence.retry: This asks the charge runner to collect payment now if the invoice is still unpaid and eligible for its automatic retry window.
consequence.refund_duplicate: This retries refunding the duplicate payment's {amount} to the card now. The existing refund is reconciled first; a refund that is already resolved is not sent again. An old refund past its safe retry window may instead be released for staff to handle.
consequence.staff_notice: This sends the staff email now if the notice still applies.
